name: Mariner's Armor

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: A Swim Speed equal to your Speed; if you start your turn underwater at 0 Hit Points, you rise 60 ft.
text: Fish and seashell designs cover this blue-green armor. Wearing it gives you a Swim Speed that matches your Speed, and if you begin your turn underwater at 0 Hit Points, it carries you 60 feet up toward the surface.
